calibrated.why: today's forward P/E is not meaningful (FY2027 consensus EPS -6.16; our FY2027 operating EPS ~$0.95 gives ~157x) and NBIS has no own P/E history (losses since the 2024 relisting); 22 = a market-average multiple held for a business still growing ~7% in 2032 (judgement, not an observed NBIS multiple). Holding today's EV/NTM sales (~5x) would equal ~34x P/E at the 2032 base margin: not credible for a 13%-ROIC, capital-heavy business.

notes.growth: 2027 base 11,500 (AV consensus 12,242, 22 analysts, range 8,809-17,987; end-2026 ARR guide $7-9B; RPO 37,490.6 at 30.6.2026 with 36% recognised by 6.2028 and 40% in months 25-48; beat record mixed: Q1-26 +2.7%, Q2-26 +1.5% vs consensus, Q3-25 and Q4-25 misses). notes.margin: operating margin after SBC and D&A from the capex-vintage side model (side.py, side_model_output.txt): revenue per $ of average gross in-service PP&E 0.44 in 2026-27 rising to 0.48 (observed: Q2-26 AI-cloud revenue x4 / average in-service gross ~0.46; ARR $3.0B / in-service gross 6,313 at 30.6.2026 = 0.475); servers 85% of capex depreciated over the disclosed 5-year life (changed from 4 years on 1.1.2026, 6-K note), other 15% over 15 years -> D&A ~37% of revenue and ~18% of gross in-service PP&E (Q2-26 actual: D&A 259.7 = 44.6% of revenue during ramp); group adj. EBITDA 46% (2027) -> 55% (AI-cloud segment Q2-26 49.7%; CoreWeave runs ~60%; the $12.05B of leases not yet commenced add lease cost); SBC 2% -> 1.5% (recurring H1-26 SBC ~63 = 6.4% of revenue, ex the 74.9 Eigen AI one-off). Base margins 3.1% (2027) -> 17.4% (2032). Bull: 0.52 turnover, 60% EBITDA -> 25%. Bear: 4-year economic life, turnover falling to 0.32, EBITDA 40-42% -> -17% to -11% in 2027-30; 2031-32 set to 5% (run-off fleet; the side model's accounting margin is inflated by fully depreciated assets; cash kept equal through the charges).
notes.conv_charges: conv = 1; charge[i] = capex - D&A - change in customer prepayments ($M), so FCF = NOPAT + D&A - capex + prepayment change. Prepayments: deferred revenue ~9,000 at end-2026 (company expects >$9B of prepayments in 2026, H1 +4,395), new prepayments = 35% of growth capex (~70% of deals prepay 50-60% of capex, Q2 call, secondary), recognised over ~3 years. Replacement of servers at 5-6 years (half at 5, half at 6). Bull charge[0] also adds back 12,985 = (Sep-2025 notes 3,400 + Mar-2026 notes 4,450 + Aug-2030 notes 3,450) x 1.149, because in the bull these notes convert into shares (shares +57.6M) and stop being debt.

EBITDA ~954 - interest ~150 + prepayments ~4,600) - H2 capex 13,900 (2026 capex 22,000 in the $20-25B guide less H1 cash capex 8,130.3) = cash ~9,490; debt (today's claims): Sep-2030/2032 notes 3,400 (conversion value 22.77M sh x $149.65 = 3,408; break-even at maturity ~$160), Mar-2031/2033 notes ~4,450 accreted (original 4,337.5), Aug-2030/2034 notes 5,750, secured 775, Citi 3,500 = 17,875 -> -8,388; + investment assets at a conservative value, separate from spendable cash: ClickHouse carried 1,517.7 x 70% = 1,060, Toloka preferred/equity ~100, Avride and TripleTen 0 (their losses sit in the group margin) -> -7,228. Leases (1,510 on the balance sheet, 12,054 not commenced) are treated as operating costs inside EBITDA. Q3 ATM sales (up to 12.27M shares) not known: GAP.
